capabilities: Resize tab headers to fit title text
Configure max/min widths, icon spacing and close-button padding
Hide tab icons and leave pinned tabs untouched
Enable scrolling tab bars with auto-centering of clicked tabs
extras: Desktop only; requires Obsidian v1.0.0 or higher.
problem: Obsidian truncates tab titles or wastes space when tab headers use fixed widths.
summary: Interface tweak plugin that automatically resizes tab header widths to fit each tab's title without truncation.
